steps.title: Beat the base
steps.body: Beat together **½ cup milk**, **½ cup heavy cream**, **1½ Tbsp cocoa powder**, **2 Tbsp zero calorie sweetener**, **2 Tbsp peanut butter**, **½ tsp vanilla extract** and **5 drops almond extract**.

steps.title: Add chia seeds
steps.body: Add, and mix in **¼ cup chia seeds**.

steps.title: Chill
steps.body: Chill in the refrigerator. Stir after 10 and 20 minutes to remove clumps as it sets.
